entries.label: Alternative Rock
entries.insert: alternative rock
entries.description: A broad rock identity suited to modern or era-specific refinement.

entries.label: Dark Folk
entries.insert: dark folk with organic acoustic weight
entries.description: A restrained folk identity emphasizing acoustic texture and shadowed tone.

entries.label: Progressive Metal
entries.insert: progressive metal with deliberate rhythmic contrast
entries.description: Heavy music built around evolving structure and rhythmic development.

entries.label: Dark Synthwave
entries.insert: dark synthwave with industrial tension
entries.description: Synth-driven retro-futurist identity with darker mechanical character.

entries.label: Neo-Soul
entries.insert: modern neo-soul with late-1970s harmonic warmth
entries.description: Modern soul language with warm harmony and a relaxed pocket.

entries.label: Ambient Instrumental
entries.insert: slow-evolving ambient instrumental
entries.description: Texture-first instrumental identity with gradual development.

entries.label: Straight Driving Pulse
entries.insert: straight driving pulse with steady forward motion
entries.description: A consistent, unswung feel that maintains momentum.

entries.label: Slow Heavy Backbeat
entries.insert: slow heavy backbeat with a double-time hi-hat feel
entries.description: Slow primary pulse with faster subdivision above it.

entries.label: Loose Swung Feel
entries.insert: loose swung groove with relaxed behind-the-beat placement
entries.description: Human rhythmic movement with a relaxed swing.

entries.label: Syncopated Accents
entries.insert: syncopated accents against a stable underlying pulse
entries.description: Off-beat emphasis while retaining a clear rhythmic anchor.

entries.label: Slow 6/8 Feel
entries.insert: slow 6/8 feel with a broad rolling pulse
entries.description: Compound-meter motion appropriate for ballads and cinematic folk.

entries.label: Muted Guitar Carries Verses
entries.insert: muted guitar carries the verses with restrained rhythmic figures
entries.description: Assigns guitar a specific supportive role instead of merely listing it.

entries.label: Bass Locks to Kick
entries.insert: bass locks tightly to the kick during the main groove
entries.description: Defines a direct rhythmic relationship between bass and drums.

entries.label: Piano Harmonic Anchor
entries.insert: piano provides the harmonic anchor with restrained voicings
entries.description: Keeps piano central without requiring constant density.

entries.label: Strings Rise Into Chorus
entries.insert: strings enter gradually before the chorus and sustain behind the hook
entries.description: Gives strings a timed arrangement function.

entries.label: Full Drums Only in Chorus
entries.insert: full live drums arrive only in the chorus
entries.description: Uses the drum entrance to create section contrast.

entries.label: Close and Conversational
entries.insert: close and conversational vocal delivery with clear articulation
entries.description: An intimate lead that remains understandable and human.

entries.label: Warm Baritone
entries.insert: warm baritone lead with controlled chest voice
entries.description: Low male register with controlled weight rather than exaggerated grit.

entries.label: Low Female Alto
entries.insert: clear low female alto with minimal vibrato
entries.description: Low female register with restrained ornamentation.

entries.label: Restrained Verse Delivery
entries.insert: restrained and speech-like in the verses
entries.description: Keeps verse intensity controlled to preserve contrast.

entries.label: Sustained Chorus Notes
entries.insert: opens into longer sustained notes at chorus peaks without shouting
entries.description: Creates vocal lift through duration and intensity rather than volume alone.

entries.label: Final-Chorus Harmony
entries.insert: two-part backing harmony enters only in the final chorus
entries.description: Reserves backing harmony for the final payoff.

entries.label: Whispered Delivery
entries.insert: [Whisper]
entries.description: Common community metatag for whispered delivery; results remain soft and model-dependent.

entries.label: Gradual Build
entries.insert: the arrangement builds gradually by adding one meaningful layer at each section
entries.description: Creates development through staged layer additions.

entries.label: Strip Down the Bridge
entries.insert: strip the bridge to voice and one supporting instrument
entries.description: Creates contrast before the final return.

entries.label: Final-Chorus Lift
entries.insert: rebuild into the final chorus with wider instrumentation and stronger harmony
entries.description: Defines concrete changes that create the final payoff.

entries.label: Rhythmic Dropout
entries.insert: drop drums and bass briefly before the next section enters
entries.description: Uses temporary absence to strengthen the following entrance.

entries.label: Instrumental Section
entries.insert: [Instrumental]
entries.description: Common structural directive for a section without lead lyrics.

entries.label: Solo Section
entries.insert: [Solo]
entries.description: Common structural directive for an instrumental spotlight.

entries.label: Silence
entries.insert: [Silence]
entries.description: Community-tested pause directive; not deterministic or officially documented syntax.

entries.label: Vocal-Forward Mix
entries.insert: clear vocal-forward mix with the lead above guitars and synths
entries.description: Defines the vocal as the primary foreground element.

entries.label: Dry and Close
entries.insert: dry close-miked lead with short room ambience only
entries.description: Reduces washed-out vocals and excessive depth.

entries.label: Wide Chorus Image
entries.insert: broaden the stereo image in the chorus while keeping the lead centered
entries.description: Uses width for section lift without losing vocal focus.

entries.label: Natural Dynamics
entries.insert: preserve natural dynamics with restrained master compression
entries.description: Avoids a uniformly flattened or over-polished result.

entries.label: Controlled Low End
entries.insert: controlled low end with clear kick and bass separation
entries.description: Keeps low-frequency elements distinct.

entries.label: Exclude Trap Hi-Hats
entries.insert: trap hi-hats
entries.description: Prevents an unwanted rhythmic production convention.

entries.label: Exclude Long Vocal Reverb
entries.insert: long vocal reverb and washed vocals
entries.description: Keeps the lead close and intelligible.

entries.label: Exclude Constant Choir
entries.insert: constant choir and excessive backing vocals
entries.description: Reserves group vocals for intentional moments.

entries.label: Exclude Overcompression
entries.insert: overcompressed drums and flattened dynamics
entries.description: Protects transient detail and dynamic contrast.

entries.label: Exclude Excessive Melisma
entries.insert: excessive melisma and constant vocal runs
entries.description: Keeps phrasing direct when ornamentation is unwanted.
